# Code Review Standards — Repository-Wide

These rules are derived directly from this repo's `AGENTS.md` and `docs/` playbook — they are not
independent style preferences. Two severity tiers are used throughout this file and its siblings:

- **[Required]** — corresponds to a MUST/MUST NOT in `AGENTS.md`. Flag a violation as a blocking
  finding: the PR should not merge as-is.
- **[Suggested]** — corresponds to a SHOULD or a "prefer X" in the playbook. Flag as a non-blocking
  suggestion the author can accept or explain.

**Before flagging a [Suggested] item, or any item that references "existing"/"sibling"/"neighboring"
code, look at the nearest analogous file already in the repo** (the same kind of handler, the same
kind of page, a sibling domain) rather than judging the new code in isolation. A new pattern that
diverges from every existing example in the same layer is a much stronger signal than a rule read
on its own.

## Architecture boundaries

- **[Required]** Flag any `<ProjectReference>` from the `Core` project to `Infrastructure` or
  `Web` — Core must not depend on either. (AGENTS.md MUST; docs/01-architecture-overview.md)
- **[Required]** Flag any class outside `Infrastructure`'s `AppBus` implementation that injects or
  calls `IMediator` directly. All use-case dispatch must go through `IAppBus.Send`/`Publish`.
  (AGENTS.md MUST)
- **[Required]** Flag a component, handler, or service that bypasses `IAppBus` to call a
  repository, an API client, or `IMediator` directly from outside `Infrastructure`/the handler
  that owns that dependency. (AGENTS.md MUST; see code-review-web-blazor.instructions.md for the
  Blazor-specific form of this)
- **[Required]** Flag business-rule validation logic (anything beyond a null/empty guard) written
  inline in a handler or a Blazor component instead of in a `ValidatorBase<TModel>` colocated with
  its model. (AGENTS.md MUST)
- **[Required]** Flag DI registrations added outside the solution's single
  `DependencyInjectionExtensions.cs` (e.g., ad hoc `services.AddX(...)` calls added directly in
  `Program.cs` or scattered across other files). All cross-cutting registration belongs in that
  one file's named extension methods. (AGENTS.md MUST; docs/01-architecture-overview.md)
- **[Required]** Flag a service that is shared across Blazor circuits (an in-memory cache, for
  example) registered as anything other than `Singleton`, and flag a session/user-scoped service
  registered as anything other than `Scoped`. A cache service registered `Scoped`/`Transient` will
  not actually share state and defeats its own purpose. (AGENTS.md MUST)
- **[Required]** Flag any hand-edit to a file generated by an external tool (an OpenAPI/NSwag
  client, generated DTOs, EF Core migration snapshots) — these must be regenerated, not
  hand-patched. Hand-written glue belongs in a separate `partial class` file. (AGENTS.md MUST;
  docs/02-bootstrap-guide.md §4)
- **[Required]** Flag a command/query handler that changes state but never calls
  `_appBus.Publish(...)` when the change is something another part of the app visibly depends on
  (e.g., an in-memory cache that would now be stale). Conversely, flag a publish call placed
  *before* the underlying write instead of after it succeeds. (AGENTS.md MUST;
  docs/03-feature-development-guide.md §4)

## Layering and leakage

- **[Required]** Flag any DTO, EF Core entity, or other wire/persistence-shape type appearing in a
  handler's public signature, a Blazor component, or anywhere in `Web`. Everything outside
  `Core`/`Infrastructure` must work exclusively in terms of Core `Model` types; conversion happens
  only immediately around the persistence-boundary call. (AGENTS.md MUST NOT;
  docs/01-architecture-overview.md — "Nothing outside Core/Infrastructure ever sees a DTO or EF
  entity")
- **[Required]** Flag business logic (calculations, cross-field rules, conditional workflows)
  implemented in `Web` or in a command/query constructor instead of in a Core handler or
  validator. Constructors only null-guard; they never validate business rules. (AGENTS.md MUST;
  docs/03-feature-development-guide.md — "What NOT to do")

## Tests: correlate behavior changes with coverage

- **[Required]** Flag a PR that adds or changes a Command, Query, Handler, domain-event handler,
  or validator under `Core` with no corresponding new/updated test under `UnitTests`. Per the
  testing guide, every handler needs a happy-path test and a guard-path test, and every validator
  rule needs its own test. (docs/04-testing-guide.md; AGENTS.md SHOULD)
- **[Required]** Flag a PR that adds a new Blazor page/route under `Web/Components/Pages/Areas/`
  with no corresponding new test under `FunctionalTests` proving the route resolves and renders.
  (docs/04-testing-guide.md; `add-functional-test` skill)
- **[Suggested]** Flag a PR that adds a repository or API-client operation under `Infrastructure`
  with no corresponding test in `IntegrationTests` (for a real-dependency concern) or a mocked
  handler test in `UnitTests` covering the new call. (docs/04-testing-guide.md)

## Duplicate/unnecessary abstractions

- **[Required]** Flag the creation of a second unit-test project (e.g., a per-source-project
  `Core.UnitTests`) alongside the solution's single `UnitTests` project — this is a known
  historical mistake the playbook explicitly calls out to not repeat. (AGENTS.md MUST NOT;
  docs/02-bootstrap-guide.md §1)
- **[Required]** Flag introduction of the in-memory cache-service pattern
  (`CacheServiceBase<TSnapshot>` + a singleton per-domain cache service) for a domain that is
  DB-backed. This pattern exists specifically to compensate for a slow/rate-limited external API;
  it is not a default and should not appear "for consistency" with an API-backed domain elsewhere
  in the same solution. (AGENTS.md SHOULD; docs/01-architecture-overview.md;
  docs/03-feature-development-guide.md — "What NOT to do")
- **[Suggested]** Flag a domain implemented with both a repository *and* API DTO-conversion
  services without a stated reason — a single domain should not normally be split across both
  persistence shapes. (docs/01-architecture-overview.md — "Persistence shape")
- **[Suggested]** Flag a new inline `.Must(...)` FluentValidation rule that duplicates an existing
  extension method in `Shared/Extensions/ValidationExtensions.cs` — check there first.
  (`add-fluentvalidation-validator` skill)
- **[Suggested]** Flag speculative empty folders/interfaces added ahead of need (e.g., an empty
  `Enums/`/`ValueObjects/` folder, or a repository interface with no handler using it yet).
  (docs/03-feature-development-guide.md — "Domain folder shape")

## Style conventions not already caught by analyzers/formatting

Keep this list short — most style is the formatter's job. These are called out because the
playbook explicitly notes they are **not** enforced by `.editorconfig` or a standard analyzer:

- **[Required]** Flag a Blazor `[Inject]` field that isn't `_camelCase` (this repo extends the
  private-field naming convention to injected fields by convention, even though they're
  `protected`, and `.editorconfig` only covers `private` fields). (AGENTS.md; docs/02-bootstrap-guide.md §2)
- **[Required]** Flag a manually written `if (x == null) throw ...` guard clause where the
  codebase's convention is the `Throw` package (`x.ThrowIfNull().Value`). (AGENTS.md MUST;
  docs/01-architecture-overview.md)
- **[Suggested]** Flag large commented-out blocks of a half-built or removed feature left in a
  diff — delete unused code rather than leaving it commented out.
  (docs/03-feature-development-guide.md — "What NOT to do")
